data.answer: Ryan Kelly and his mom, Daniela, appeared on Shark Tank Season 5 Episode 16, showcasing their homemade pet treat company, Ryan's Barkery. The business received an update from the Shark Tank crew, indicating its progress. To enhance their brand, they changed the name from Ryan's Barkery to Ryan's Ruffery, which continued to flourish, making over $10,000 in sales. The sources don't provide a definitive answer on the current status of Ryan's Ruffery beyond this update.
